notes.title: V1.0.18
notes.content:

- Store rotation enhancements

notes.title: v1.0.17
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2]
Hollow’s Eve is almost upon us! Prepare for some spooky antics coming to the world of Super Dragon Punch Force 3!

[h2][b]Enhancements[/b][/h2]
Store notifications have been improved.

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
The SF Evidence Hall background has been fixed.
Game no longer freezes on the Join Game screen.
Issues emerging while scrolling the Reward Tracks have been fixed.

notes.title: v1.0.16
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h2]
Push Notifications have been added to Challenges.

[h2][b]EHANCEMENTS[/b][/h2]
Profile scrolling has been improved.
Results screen has been improved.
Score Display has been improved.

[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
Skipping the Tutorial while offline no longer triggers a loop.
Getting hit with the Triplets when playing as Jace no longer counts as an opponent counter.
You can access your Profile from the Player Banner on Results and Match History screens.
Marlo’s hit reactions have been improved.
Forfeiting a PVE Casual match no longer stops a player from interacting with the UI.
Controllers no longer lose focus when Popups appear.
Zed’s resolution in the Tutorial improved.
SF Evidence Hall now appears correctly on some Android devices.
Controllers can now properly connect mid-game.

notes.title: v1.0.15
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h2]
Reward Track //02 is here!
Unlock new Emotes and Skins for Wally, June27 and Yazya!
New Profile customization options added!
New sounds in the Main Menu!

[h2][b]EHANCEMENTS[/b][/h2]
Adjusted hitboxes for a more consistent experience.
Easier hotkey identification in the Tutorial.

[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
Fixed the aspect ratio not properly scaling on the loading screen.
Wally's throw against SK and Marlo Ability 3 fixed.
Deb's Divine Intervention Super now adds Punch Force to opponent's bar.
Wally now reflects Deb's Divine Intervention Super properly.
Jace can now properly block SK's Sonic Sweep Super.
Yazya's first hit in her Spirit Storm Super no longer instantly defeats an opponent.
Menu button behavior fixed.
All Emotes now work properly.

notes.title: v1.0.14b
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
Fixed an issue where customizing your profile could wrongly make it appear as if there was a connection error.

notes.title: v1.0.14a
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
Fixed a critical matchmaking issue.

notes.title: v1.0.14
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h2]
Add and challenge friends with the new Social system.
New Yazya mastery stats.
New Jace mastery stats.

[h2][b]ENHANCEMENTS[/b][/h2]
Improved UI clarity.
Stat tracking accuracy has been improved.
Stat panel colors have been simplified.
Implemented a new loading screen.
Store UI has been improved.

[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
Stats are now updating after every match.
Account name creation fixed.
Fixed being unable to close an opponent's profile.
Fixed CPU names not displaying correctly.

[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h2]
Earn free characters and cosmetics with the Initiate Track.
Round transitions have new visuals.

[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
Entering the Store Menu now plays the correct sound.
Win streaks now reset after a match is forfeited.
Emote wheel no longer gets stuck on screen.
Arcade machine video fidelity has been improved.
SK's Sonic Sweep will now stop after she's defeated.
On controller, the Store no longer opens while in the Characters Menu.
Bug reporting no longer creates an infinite loading screen.

[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
Match History now has the correct background.
Facebook social link has been fixed.
Fixed graphics settings display bug.
You no longer need to reset your region after customizing your account.

[h2][b]ENHANCEMENTS[/b][/h2]
Character names have been added to the intros.
Introduced accurate error message handling.
Characters available in free rotation are now more clearly defined.
You can now earn Tickets as rewards from Private Matches.

[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
Double log in fixed.
No more errors when backing out in a PvP lobby.
Main Poster is transparency fixed.
Improved controller support on Bug Report menu.
Added spam protection to the Bug Report menu.
Fixed equipping multiple Store items affecting Profile.

[h2][b]ENHANCEMENTS[/b][/h2]
Pause Menu updated.
Character texture sizes improved.
Space Bar added to virtual keyboard.

[h2][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h2]
Guest Sign In mode before having to sign in

======================================================================
BUG FIXES
Pressing Enter or A on a Gamepad no longer instantly locks in a Character. 
You can now back out of a fight in a Private Match. 
You and your opponent will no longer be able to use the same skin.
Only one Store transaction can occur at a time.
Fixed an infinite loading screen bug. 
Controller will no longer turn on and off during gameplay.
Controller will no longer focus elsewhere in the Store.
Winning a single round no longer results in winning both rounds.
Controller will no longer focus elsewhere after a successful purchase.
Deb  will no longer become invisible after a throw tech.
AI health will no longer increase after a rematch.
Info button will no longer be highlighted by default.
Jace will no longer switch orientation after being thrown during his Prototype: Beamo attack.
Boy will no longer have his Loaded passive active indefinitely after being hit with a projectile.
Start button is no longer un-interactable during matchmaking.
Blocking June27’s Super no longer causes more damage than not blocking. 
To prevent an empty lobby, the Cancel Matchmaking button is now disabled when a match is found.
The Final Hit sound now plays correctly after Final Round.
Play button sound now playing correctly. 
Keyboard controls will no longer be locked when using a mouse in fight.
The Pause button is now clickable when gesture inputs are hidden.
Deb's throw now does the correct damage.
Player indicator no longer gets stuck on screen.
You can no longer close the Steam overlay during a transaction.
Characters will no longer T-pose during a Ranked Match.
Quitting with more health than the opponent during a Ranked PvE match will no longer result in Victory.
The health bar display has been improved.
Fight Timer on 21:9 phone screens now displays at the correct resolution.
Opponent death animations improved.
Controllers can now properly scroll down in the Settings menu.
Store item statuses will now display correctly in the Profile.
The Quit button has been removed when redeeming an invalid code from promo codes.
Loading Screen aspect ratio scaling has been adjusted.

NEW FEATURES
June27's Recall reworked to be more consistent.
Player account statistics improved.
Marlo, Wally and June27's individual statistics improved.

ENHANCEMENTS
The game's user interface has been optimized.
Keyboard navigation has been improved.
You can now Block and Parry Yazya's Shadowcut ability.
The Character menu has been re-ordered.
The Emote wheel is now in front of the Characters.
The Results screen has been improved.
Indicators added when selected Characters are locked in.
The scrolling speed has been improved.
Social features have been moved to the Settings Menu.
Wally's Khaki and Peacekeeper skin textures have been updated. 
Wally Survivor, Yazya Goth-casual and SK Vintage skins have been improved.
The sign in process has been improved.
The virtual keyboard has been improved.
The Arcade machine video has been replaced.
The Character outros have been reworked.
All Character hit reactions have been altered.
The Global Leaderboard will now always show the top 100, with your position listed separately if not in the top 100 players.
======================================================================

================================================================
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Get to know the game with the new tutorial.
[*] Type faster with a virtual keyboard for controllers.
[*] Identify yourself more easily with the new player indicator.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple player account-breaking bugs.
[*] Ranked PvE results screen fixed.
[*] Animations will now finish before the results screen is displayed.
[/list]

[b]Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved matchmaking experience.
[*] All characters available to play in practice mode.
[*] New collections screen.
[*] Improved store user interface.
[*] Both players can now use emotes simultaneously.
[*] Improved AI opponents for more responsiveness on harder difficulties.
[*] Audio improvements to the user interface.
[*] Marlo, Wally, and June27 have new hit reaction animations.
[*] Improved skin textures for Boy Bad Apple, Wally Bad Apple, and Wally Umbral skins.
[/list]
=================================================================
Fixed a critical issue where store items wouldn't load

- Controller support has been improved!
- User Interface visuals have been updated!
- Characters have been re-balanced with improved damage and slight changes to hit probation! 
- Stat tracking has been improved and is now a lot more accurate!
- Along with several minor bug fixes!

notes.title: v0.20240502.5
notes.content:
We're resetting the leaderboards to promote a better competitive spirit!
Rewards have been added to PvP Quick Play matches!
Fixed Rewards not showing up immediately after a Match.
Implemented Daily Store Rotation - daily discounts on items in the rotation! 
No more frame delays when transitioning from PvP to PvE.
Fixed emote hotkeys not working in PvP.
Implemented a dedicated loading screen
Game pad fixes!
Improved Region Selection for PvP play!
